systemBoundary: Local synthetic service-work coordination: inspect records, ask for missing information, and prepare a proposal; no real person, system, equipment, or safety action.

decisions.decision: Define the service-request task and beneficiary
decisions.escalation: stop if beneficiary or consequence is undefined
agent must not diagnose or authorize safety work
disable model-directed action if deterministic enforcement is absent
degrade or stop on unavailable persistence
no effect when authority is missing or expired

handoff.openQuestion: Can bounded model-directed action solve the non-enumerable remainder better than the fixed baseline?
